summary: The trace shows an agent successfully applying the existing excel-audit-reporting skill patterns, but encountering a specific confusion: pandas readback showed NaN for Error Summary cells while openpyxl verification showed the correct 'None' strings. This confusion is already documented in references/nan-none-handling.md but deserves a more prominent troubleshooting note in the main SKILL.md since agents repeatedly trip on it. Adding a specific troubleshooting entry for this pandas-vs-openpyxl readback discrepancy.
